requiredRule: Never assign finger gestures to an arm lowered in the target pose. Evaluate sides independently; hiding a required hand never removes the active requirement.
implementationStatus: Specification only. Connect to the game tracking and scoring logic.
loweredArmDefinition: Arm is lowered in the TARGET pose, not merely in the current camera observation.
visibilityAndTrackingFieldsApplyTo: Feasibility at generation and confidence of observations; never silently remove an assigned scoring component.
stableTrackingMeaning: Reliable observation, not an artificial multi-second recognition delay.
compatibilityNote: Candidate hands only. Further check simultaneous gesture compatibility, self-occlusion and seated camera framing.
coordinateConvention: Screen-right cue means player right arm. Mirror only pictograms, not captions.
